title: Rav Yosef, Son of Rav Shemayah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Shemaya.
He was Rav Papa’s student, raising objections to him in Eruvin 41b, Menachot 9b and Temurah 14b. Shabbat 33b preserves a valuable statement of his:
When a generation contains righteous people, they are taken in punishment for the generation; when it contains no righteous people, the schoolchildren are taken instead.

notes.text: The saying contrasts righteous people and schoolchildren bearing a generation’s punishment. Papa is the contextual expansion of the teacher’s initial.

The consulted Shabbat 33b offers Rabbi Guryon as an alternative transmitter and calls Yosef the son of Rabbi Shemayah. Hyman supplies Rav Yosef son of Rav Shemayah. Those title and transmitter differences are not harmonized.
